LZ4 frame format ported from pierrec/lz4 semantics.

Own block compressor (fast LZ4, 12-bit hash table, forward + backward match extension) and decompressor, plus the frame container: magic, FLG/BD descriptors, header checksum, stored/compressed blocks, EndMark, xxHash32 content verification. Skippable frames are skipped, concatenated frames decoded in sequence. Works on Input/Output: no stream objects, no per-call output allocation when the caller reuses an Output.

One-shot LZ4 frame compress. level accepted for API parity with Go (fast path always). Writes FLG 0x64 / BD 0x40: independent blocks, content checksum, 64KB blocks, no content size.

proc lz4DecompressBlock(blk: Span; dst: Output) {....raises: [Lz4Error, IoError],
    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Decompress one raw LZ4 block into dst. Raises Lz4Error. Output may exceed the block size; offsets reach back into all previously decoded content (dependent blocks supported).

    tags: [], forbids: [].}
Decompress concatenated LZ4 frames at the cursor into dst, verifying header/block/content checksums. Skippable frames are skipped. Raises Lz4Error on any corruption.
